verdict.rationale: LM Studio stores models, chats, and configs locally (docs-6) and models themselves are open-format (GGUF/MLX), so users aren't locked into a cloud silo, but there is no documented 'export all data' feature and the app itself is closed-source with a restrictive license (comm-4, comm-8, comm-15, comm-18), undercutting the openness story.
